name: ModifyDataSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka.

obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

wafApi: the API used to download attack logs from Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF)
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值：
ckafka：腾讯云ckafka。
obs：华为云obs。
wafApi：腾讯云waf攻击日志下载API
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source. The ID is an MD5 hash that is calculated based on the values of other parameters. You can call the DescribeDataSourceInstance (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CDescribeDataSourceInstance) operation to obtain the data source ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。
可调用DescribeDataSourceInstance (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|DescribeDataSourceInstance)获取数据源ID
parameters.name: data_source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: data_source_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the data source
parameters.name: data_source_instance_remark

parameters.help_en: The parameters of the data source, in a JSON array format
parameters.name: data_source_instance_params

parameters.help_en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
